dedupe_keys.name: dynalird vietnam 220 kv line weather ratings and adversarial variants

description: DynaLiRD combines hourly weather and line parameters with calculated dynamic ratings for the Trang–Thap Cham 220-kilovolt overhead line in Vietnam. The Mendeley description reports 13,128 hourly observations from 1 January 2020 through 30 June 2021. Weather fields include air temperature, wind speed and direction, and global horizontal irradiance. The rating calculation follows IEEE 738-2012; separate CSVs contain perturbed examples made with FGSM and BIM attacks at specified strengths. The current version 3 is public under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one transmission corridor, not a national grid or measured real-time conductor temperature at every span. The ratings are computed from weather and conductor assumptions, while adversarial examples are constructed, not observed incidents. A reviewer-assessed use is testing capacity constraints or forecasting robustness in transmission simulations. model-pypsa is a related power-system planning tool, but no direct importer is verified. A linked GitHub repository has model folders that require separate identity review. No data files, trained models or code were downloaded.
